title: Hypothesis
description: A proposed explanation for one or more observations or questions. A testable claim under investigation.

id.description: Globally unique slug identifier using lowercase kebab-case.

title.description: A concise statement of the hypothesis.

discussion.description: ID of the Discussion this hypothesis belongs to.

addresses.description: IDs of Questions this hypothesis proposes to answer.

based_on.description: IDs of Observations this hypothesis draws from.

created.description: ISO 8601 date when this hypothesis was proposed.

created_by.description: GitHub username of the contributor who proposed this hypothesis.

tested_by.description: IDs of Experiment artifacts that test this hypothesis.

tags.description: Free-form labels for discovery and filtering.
